mapper.insert: insert into product_sku ( sku_code, sku_name, product_id, thumb_img, sale_price, market_price, cost_price, stock_num, sale_num, sku_spec, weight, volume, status, create_time, update_time, is_deleted ) values ( #{skuCode}, #{skuName}, #{productId}, #{thumbImg}, #{salePrice}, #{marketPrice}, #{costPrice}, #{stockNum}, #{saleNum}, #{skuSpec}, #{weight}, #{volume}, #{status}, now(), now(), 0 )
mapper.update: update product_sku set is_deleted = 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update product_sku set is_deleted = 1, update_time = now() where product_id = #{productId}
